name: Can I visit or view model tiny homes before purchase?

mainEntity.name: Can I visit or view model tiny homes before purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can see floor plans and completed projects online; in-person viewings or site tours are available by appointment after submitting a buyer’s application or deposit.​
